name: ballast bed
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 轨枕下部及周围承担支承作用的道砟层。
usage_overview: 道床通过道砟颗粒与轨枕的相互作用提供支承和横向约束，可作为研究轨枕横向阻力及骨料摩擦影响的结构对象。

complete_examples.text: Firstly, the DEM model of the sleeper-ballast bed is introduced and described.
The lateral resistance of the ballast bed is determined when the lateral displacement of the sleepers reaches 2mm.

P074.title: DEM Analysis of Lateral Sleeper Resistance Effect of Sleeper-Ballast Interaction and Aggregate Friction
